gaps.next_action: Use the Work Item PM plan-mode gate for future work-item orchestration; keep broader semantic plan freshness validation as future policy/validator work only if explicitly scoped.

gaps.title: Trust Verifier Cutover Gate needs explicit triage
gaps.rationale: BANDIT-064 materialized the Trust Verifier Cutover Gate contract as repo-native policy, added a fail-closed validator and `bandit trust cutover-gates validate` command, registered validation/init/path wiring, and recorded the current no-cutover-approved disposition. Actual Trust Verifier cutover approval, old-gate replacement, or old-gate wrapping remains operator-owned and separately blocked.
gaps.next_action: Use the Trust Verifier Cutover Gate policy and validator before any future per-Trust-Goal cutover decision; do not approve cutover or replace/wrap old gates without separate operator-owned authorization and evidence.

gaps.title: Harness-portable orchestrator prompt contract

gaps.next_action: Use the orchestrator prompt contract as non-authoritative harness guidance while Bandit CLI evidence and gates remain canonical.

gaps.title: Private Installable Distribution And Update Notification Channel
gaps.rationale: BANDIT-071 delivered the Private Installable Distribution And Update Notification Channel as a repo-native private install/update policy, package scoping and runtime loader fix, init defaults, templates, update-check command, update-channel cache behavior, and focused verification.
